authority: This JSON is authoritative. The Markdown twin is explanatory and cannot weaken it.
purpose: Give the unchanged rank_breadth_reversal_4h short cell one new causal identity on three unopened folds without reusing viewed evidence.

candidate.allowed_change: bind the unchanged source short rule to causal PIT CORE-20 context, next-open signal/time fills and the frozen marked-equity book; all signal and management values remain unchanged

contaminated_context.rule: Preserve this result in the full trial ledger as contaminated selection context only. It cannot satisfy any gate, seed a parameter, select a fold or be pooled with the new evaluation.
contaminated_context.multiplicity: Register the new identity as another trial, retain all prior candidates and rejections, and report raw plus Holm-adjusted inference as diagnostics only. Never erase a failed trial.

point_in_time_signal.universe: For every completed decision candle d, use only symbols present in the checksum-bound weekly PIT CORE-20 membership snapshot available at d; current membership and union-of-fold membership are forbidden.
point_in_time_signal.rank: rank7 is the descending cross-sectional rank of each eligible member's causal 42-bar return at d; ties use the source pandas average-rank semantics. A member without both d and d-42 closes is excluded from rank7_n, not assigned a future value.
point_in_time_signal.breadth: breadth7 is count(causal 42-bar return > 0) divided by rank7_n at d over that same PIT membership and data-eligible set.
point_in_time_signal.short_entry: top ceil(0.20 * rank7_n), breadth7 >= 0.65, RSI2 crosses below 70 on a red decision candle, volume >= 0.80 * the median of the prior 42 completed volumes, and 1.5*ATR/close >= 5*2*(0.0005+0.0002)
point_in_time_signal.availability: Every membership, close, volume, ATR, RSI, rank and breadth input must have available_at <= decision candle close; restated, later-listed or later-ingested information is forbidden.

pit_authority.core20_derivation: At decision close d, choose the unique week with greatest monday_ms <= d. CORE-20 is exactly week.books.crypto.members[0:20], preserving artifact order; fewer than 20 members is INCOMPLETE_CANDIDATE. No static, current, union or cross-book substitute exists.
pit_authority.artifact_order_rule: The artifact ranks exact Decimal 30-day USDT quote-volume descending within crypto after its frozen vetoes; exact-volume ties are symbol ascending. CORE-20 and simultaneous-entry order both preserve the first-20 artifact order. Signal rank7 remains a separate pandas average rank of causal 42-bar returns within those members.
pit_authority.pre_market_row_validation: Before any candle, mark, funding, exchange-rule or holdout row is opened: verify the three byte hashes; parse JSON/gzip; validate manifest canonical digest/schema/loader/source/survivor flag; validate universe canonical digest, format/id, manifest/classes digests and exact books; require 348 unique strictly increasing Monday-00:00-UTC weeks from 2020-02-03 through 2026-09-28; for every week require exact book keys, aligned unique members/qv arrays of at most 40 ASCII symbols, finite nonnegative exact-Decimal qv, descending qv and symbol-ascending ties. Any mismatch refuses before a market read.
pit_authority.no_forward_membership: A decision may use only the greatest validated weekly row whose monday_ms <= decision close. No later weekly row may affect membership, ranks, breadth, eligibility or order.

execution.exchange_filter_rule: Query the checksum-bound point-in-time exchange rules in force at every entry, partial and final exit; never reuse entry rules for a later fill. Missing coverage makes the whole candidate INCOMPLETE.
execution.event_timeline: For decision candle d, first complete its entire intrabar path for positions already open. Only positions still open at d close receive the source signal/time-exit decision. At next bar open t, after funding_time < t, causal marks and Cairo roll, execute every due next-open signal/time exit at the unslipped reference open with adverse executable pricing before any entry attempt or fill-bar gap/intrabar event. Then apply re-entry locks and attempt entries in CORE-20 order, settle funding_time == t, and finally run the fill bar intrabar path. Thus a due signal/time exit at t wins over a fill-bar gap-stop classification; a position closed during d intrabar creates no close decision at d.

reentry_lock_semantics.scope: candidate book + symbol + side; the opposite side is independent
reentry_lock_semantics.block_predicate: entry_decision_open_ms <= associated_exit_decision_open_ms; in a correctly ordered replay equality is the ordinary same-candle lock and a strict-less value is a stale/out-of-order entry that also fails closed
reentry_lock_semantics.signal_or_time_exit: Associate the exit with the completed decision candle that scheduled its next-open fill. Block an entry decision from that exact same decision candle; the following completed candle is eligible.
reentry_lock_semantics.intrabar_exit: Associate stop, TP1/full-target or any other intrabar final exit with the candle whose path filled it. Block an entry decision at that candle close; the following completed candle is eligible.
reentry_lock_semantics.determinism: Persist exit reason, fill time and associated decision-candle open. Compare canonical UTC candle-open milliseconds. Unknown/malformed time or reason is INCOMPLETE_CANDIDATE, never an unlocked entry.
reentry_lock_semantics.source_parity: Matches engine.py Engine.reentry_lock: only the same associated candle is locked and next candle is eligible; cycle exits map back one timeframe while intrabar exits map to their fill candle.

intrabar_rule.lineage: FBL-BT01 semantics from backtest.py path_points and walk_path, encoded here so later source edits cannot change this evaluation
intrabar_rule.gap_stop: if the bar opens at or beyond the stop, fill the entire remaining position at the open before any target, partial, breakeven or other event
intrabar_rule.both_stop_and_favourable_level: if the stop frozen at bar open lies inside the bar range, the stop wins for the candle and favourable exits are suppressed
intrabar_rule.monotonic_leg_order: otherwise fire reached levels in price order along each declared path leg
intrabar_rule.target_and_partial_reference_fill: fill at the frozen trigger level; a favourable gap receives no price improvement
intrabar_rule.partial_then_management: after a partial, update quantity once; breakeven ratchets only after the completed favourable leg and can be hit only on a later adverse leg
intrabar_rule.signal_and_time_order: process the full intrabar path first; if still open, a signal or time decision fills only at its frozen next-open index

management_semantics.entry_atr: ATR_entry is the source ATR at completed decision bar d and must be finite and positive; no entry-bar high, low, close or ATR may be read
management_semantics.entry_price_basis: entry_exec is the adverse-slipped, frozen-tick-rounded executable price at entry index e; every initial management level and R uses entry_exec
management_semantics.initial_quantity: qty_raw = risk_cash / R_price; apply leverage cap, then floor to the point-in-time MARKET_LOT_SIZE step; skip rather than round up when minQty/minNotional fails and refuse rather than clip when maxQty fails
management_semantics.level_precision: management trigger levels remain exact formula values; executable fill prices alone are adverse-rounded to the point-in-time tick
management_semantics.tp1: tp1 = entry_exec - 1.0 * R_price and requests half the current quantity
management_semantics.partial_quantity: floor the requested half close to MARKET_LOT_SIZE; if zero, send nothing, do not mark TP1 complete and permit a later retry; floor remaining quantity after a fill
management_semantics.partial_dust: TP1 never auto-converts dust to a full close; full exits close all remaining model quantity
management_semantics.breakeven: after a completed favourable leg reaches entry_exec - 1.0 * R_price, tighten stop toward entry_exec and never loosen it
management_semantics.full_target: target = entry_exec - 2.0 * R_price and closes all remaining quantity
management_semantics.best_price: initialize to entry_exec and update only after each completed path leg
management_semantics.fill_accounting: every partial and full fill uses single-count reference-price PnL, adverse slippage, fee and funding rules

book_and_sizing.entry_attempt_phase: At bar open t, settle funding_time < t, freeze causal marks and any new Cairo day baseline, execute every due signal/time exit, then calculate entry terms. Attempt simultaneous requests sequentially in frozen PIT CORE order. Settle funding_time == t after all same-open attempts; run intrabar management last.
book_and_sizing.marked_equity_formula: settled_cash_equity + sum(side_sign * remaining_qty * (causal_mark - unslipped_reference_entry)) over open positions
book_and_sizing.mark_timestamp_basis: Existing positions use the last checksum-verified 1h mark close with availability timestamp <= t; a position admitted at t uses its unslipped reference open for same-open sizing.
book_and_sizing.risk_cash_formula: risk_cash = current marked candidate-book equity * 0.01 at each sequential entry attempt
book_and_sizing.gross_open_notional_formula: sum(abs(remaining_qty * causal_mark)) over open positions; same-open admissions use their unslipped reference open
book_and_sizing.leverage_notional_cap_formula: max(0, 10.0 * current marked candidate-book equity - current gross open notional)
book_and_sizing.entry_priority: the checksum-bound PIT CORE-20 order in force at t; caller order cannot change it
book_and_sizing.daily_halt_timezone: Africa/Cairo resolved through the IANA timezone database for every timestamp
book_and_sizing.daily_halt_rule: At the first open in a new Cairo calendar day, after funding_time < t and causal marks but before fills or funding_time == t, freeze day_start_equity and clear the prior latch. Execute due exits, then test the 8% threshold before the first entry and after every entry cost, exact-time funding settlement, partial and final exit. A latched halt blocks only later new entries that day; exits and management never stop.
book_and_sizing.caller_override: forbidden; changing a value, formula or ordering creates a new contract and evaluation identity

costs.funding: checksum-verified actual Binance USD-M funding at every settlement t with entry_fill_time <= t < exit_fill_time, using the last causal verified mark
costs.funding_sign: signed_funding_cash = -signed_position_notional * funding_rate; a positive rate is a receipt for a short
costs.price_pnl_basis: gross reference-price PnL uses unslipped reference prices only
costs.adverse_slippage_cash: subtract the nonnegative reference-to-adverse-executable cash difference exactly once
costs.adverse_fill_rule: shift every buy upward and sell downward by the stress-adjusted slippage, round to the point-in-time tick against the strategy, then charge fees on executable notional
costs.cost_stress_rule: multiply fees, adverse slippage and negative funding debits; positive funding credits remain at 1.0x

verdict_math.initial_risk_cash: For each admitted episode, initial_risk_cash = initial_filled_quantity_after_leverage_cap_and_step_floor * R_price. Record requested_risk_budget separately. Initial risk cash is immutable after entry and must be finite and >0.
verdict_math.trade_r: episode_net_cash / initial_risk_cash, where episode_net_cash is gross reference-price PnL plus signed funding credits/debits minus fees and adverse slippage across entry, every partial and final exit exactly once
verdict_math.net_r: math.fsum(trade_r for every fully closed episode across wf1, wf2, wf3)
verdict_math.mean_r: net_r / closed_episode_count; zero episodes reports null and fails sample/economic gates
verdict_math.profit_factor: math.fsum(positive trade_r) / abs(math.fsum(negative trade_r)); positive numerator with zero denominator reports Infinity, otherwise zero denominator reports 0
verdict_math.win_rate: count(trade_r > 0) / closed_episode_count; exact zero is not a win
verdict_math.fold_net_r: math.fsum(trade_r) inside each named fold; folds never pool to manufacture the 2-of-3 gate
verdict_math.cashflow_drawdown_r: For every episode, normalize each entry fee/slippage, funding settlement, partial realized PnL/fee/slippage and final realized PnL/fee/slippage cashflow by that episode's immutable initial_risk_cash. Within each fold sort by event_time_ms; cashflows sharing an exact timestamp are math.fsum'd atomically before updating cumulative R and peak, so symbol/CORE iteration cannot improve or worsen drawdown. Peak starts at 0; fold DD is max(peak-cumulative); promotion max_dd_r is max of the three fold DDs, never a carried cross-fold curve.
verdict_math.marked_equity_drawdown: Also report each fold's maximum marked-equity cash and percentage drawdown using the causal mark after every frozen event phase and bar; it is required disclosure but does not replace the max_dd_r gate.
verdict_math.symbol_contribution: symbol_net_r = math.fsum(trade_r for that symbol). concentration = max(abs(symbol_net_r)) / math.fsum(abs(symbol_net_r) for all symbols with a close). A zero denominator reports 1.0 and fails. Minimum-symbol count uses distinct symbols with at least one fully closed episode.
verdict_math.numeric_order: Use IEEE-754 binary64 inputs and math.fsum for every aggregation. Sort folds by contract order, times ascending and identity ties by symbol then entry_time_ms then immutable episode_id before serialization.
verdict_math.stress_replay: Run three independent full causal books from 500 USDT at 1.0x, 1.5x and 2.0x. Each replay reapplies costs at every fill/funding event and therefore recomputes settled cash, marked equity, risk size, step floor, leverage capacity, daily halt, occupancy, later admissions, exits and all metrics. Repricing a fixed base trade list post hoc is forbidden.
verdict_math.cost_distance_screen_under_stress: The source entry screen remains the identity-defining base formula 1.5*ATR/close >= 5*2*(5bp+2bp) in all three replays. Stress multipliers change realized economics/book state only; they do not retune the signal screen or create different signal parameters.
verdict_math.promotion_cost_row: All base economic/sample/risk gates use the 1.0x full replay. positive_after_1_5x_cost_stress uses only the 1.5x full replay aggregate net_r > 0. The 2.0x full replay is required diagnostic disclosure.

statistics.role: required selection-bias diagnostics only; no raw, bootstrap or Holm value is a promotion gate

raw_p_value.test: one-sided Monte Carlo sign-flip test of after-cost net R versus zero
raw_p_value.unit: UTC calendar exit day; sum all fully closed episode trade_r on that day with math.fsum; days without a close are omitted
raw_p_value.formula: (1 + count(T_star >= T_observed)) / 100001; each T_star independently multiplies every day unit by an equiprobable -1 or +1; comparison is inclusive

bootstrap_ci_95_mean_r.unit: UTC calendar exit-day cluster carrying that day's ordered trade_r values
bootstrap_ci_95_mean_r.procedure: sample the observed exit-day clusters with replacement, preserving all trades inside a selected day; replicate mean = math.fsum(all sampled trade_r) / sampled trade count
bootstrap_ci_95_mean_r.interval: ordinary percentile [quantile(method=linear,0.025), quantile(method=linear,0.975)]; never called Holm-adjusted
bootstrap_ci_95_mean_r.empty_sample: [null,null] with failure_reason NO_CLOSED_EPISODES; it cannot satisfy required-report or promotion gates

family_ledger.rule: Validate byte hash and canonical digest before market reads. The two contaminated prior trials remain in the family and receive conservative raw p=1.0 because no preregistered raw p exists; the new trial supplies its frozen raw p. Any additional family trial requires a new append-only ledger identity and contract.

statistics.holm_adjustment: Sort (raw_p, trial_id) ascending. For sorted index j=1..m, adjusted_j = max over k<=j of min(1,(m-k+1)*raw_p_k); map back to trial IDs. Exact-p ties use trial_id ascending. Report all three raw and adjusted values.

data.universe: checksum-bound weekly point-in-time CORE-20 membership and order

split_rules.bar_index_model: Each fold has local bars 0..N-1 and end-exclusive index N; a decision at d fills entry at e=d+1
split_rules.terminal_fill_inequality: every actual exit fill index x satisfies e <= x < N

promotion_gates.monthly_bucket_rule: count closes in every UTC calendar month intersecting each fold and include zero-close months before taking the median
promotion_gates.regime_definition: BTC 4h close above/on versus below its causal EMA200 at the candidate decision candle
promotion_gates.incomplete_scope: Any missing PIT membership, candle, funding, mark, tradable next open, exchange rule or required report makes the entire candidate INCOMPLETE; rows may not be dropped to manufacture a passing sample.

stop_conditions: Any contract, source signal, parameters, management or event-order byte change creates a new candidate identity.
Any market or archive read before contract merge, or at/after 2026-09-28, refuses the run before evidence is produced.
A losing-after-cost candidate is rejected and receives no cohort risk.
No result may weaken a gate, select a fold, change a universe, tune a threshold or reuse the viewed holdout.
